name: oauthStatus
description: Read the live OAuth connection state for an OAuth-backed provider (chatgpt-pro / github-copilot / qwen-code / ...). Used by the Models settings page to poll while a sign-in is in progress and reflect the connected email once the loopback redirect (or device-code authorization) has stored tokens. Replaces the chrome.send 'getProviderOAuthStatus' route. Non-secret response: {connected, connectedEmail?}. Exposed on the panel WebUI bridge port only.

inputs.name: providerId
inputs.description: Provider id with an OAuth flow (chatgpt-pro / github-copilot / qwen-code / ...)
